## Research Subject
A clear and concise description of the scientific or engineering subject area (e.g. routing congestion, antenna efficiency, battery chemistry).

## Research Objectives
What are the primary questions you intend to answer or hypotheses you intend to test?

## Background & Existing Works
Summarize existing research, papers, RFCs, or standards that form the basis of this study.

## Proposed Methodology
How will the research be executed?
* Simulations (using `beacon-simulator`)
* Hardware bench tests
* Field range testing
* Theoretical/mathematical proofs

## Expected Output & Deliverables
What will the end result of this research look like? (e.g., a new ADR, a performance benchmark report, a new schema definition).
